blockers.detail: The source inventory includes build/test/platform supersets. Confirm exact redistributed static/native components, their generated inputs and rebuild/relink materials against the original binaries; a download success alone is not proof of complete Corresponding Source.

66 candidate source archives still need notice/scope review (55 have no recognized separate notice or inline header). Standard license texts, upstream author metadata and full original source are retained. These counts do not imply that every candidate is present in the shipped Windows binary.

GPL/LGPL tools run as separate standard CLI processes but are embedded in a single outer executable and hash-pinned on extraction. Confirm aggregation/combined-work scope and any applicable modification/relink/install rights, or use an independently replaceable side-by-side tool package.
